metadata.title: Bilahir Tok | Tomato Chutney| Assamese Recipe
metadata.description:
Bilahir Tok is a tangy tomato chutney made by reducing juicy ripe tomatoes to a thick oily pulp and by adding just the right balance of red chili powder and sugar. The bay leaves and the panch poran give it a hint of fragrance that elevates this simple and humble dish. This dish can be enjoyed with rotis or with rice as a side. Following are the ingredients that are required to make this dish;

Ingredients required

Tomatoes - 4-5 medium sized
Dried red chilies - 3 nos
Bay leaf - 1 no
Turmeric - 1 tsp
Chili Powder - 1 tbsp
Sugar - 1/2 tbsp
panchporan - 1 tsp
Salt to taste
